summary: Frontend-only smoke and regression test after code-quality refactors (useCallback, stable keys, SLIDE_INTERVAL_MS constant, AlbumCardContent extraction). All sections load, navbar/nav links present, YouTube iframes render (main + 9 grid), live slider works (manual next/prev, dot navigation, auto-advance ~4s), Live and Collaborations year accordions expand/collapse correctly, Bio 'Leggi tutto' expands paragraphs from 3 -> 16, discography renders 3 albums + 2 EPs, footer social links have correct hrefs (Instagram/YouTube/Spotify/Facebook). No console errors and no .error elements detected.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveSection: inside the expanded events map, the key `${year}-${perf.event.substring(0,20)}-${index}` still contains index; since events per year can have duplicate event strings (e.g. multiple 'Caffè Tritolo' in 2008), the composite key can collide across renders when list mutates. Fine for a static list, but consider adding location to the key for future-proofing.

CollaborationsSection expanded items still use `key={`collab-${year}-${index}`}` (index-based). Acceptable because data is static, but if the underlying data ever becomes reorderable this will cause React reconciliation issues.
Slider dot uses `key={index}` on line 576 — same static-list caveat; a stable key like the image URL would be preferable (`key={photo}`).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is fully static. All sections verified via data-testid selectors. Refactors did not regress functionality. Only remaining nits are 3 residual index-based keys inside expanded lists (Live events, Collab items, slider dots) — non-blocking. Auto-advance interval SLIDE_INTERVAL_MS=4000ms confirmed working.
